[ASSISTANT_SAID] The novel uses a stream-of-consciousness narrative style and nonlinear structure, reflecting Holden Caulfield's fractured mental state.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The story is divided into disconnected episodes presented in a non-chronological order, creating disorientation and mirroring Holden's alienation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The overall message is about the challenges of growing up and finding one's place in society, conveyed through the novel's structure.
